name: network-telemetry
//: llmlint: ignore-file[e2e_not_mocked] The hermetic tests of the live tier's network recorder (scripts/e2e-netshim.sh, scripts/e2e-netmeasure.py, scripts/e2e-lib.sh's telemetry helpers) and of live-codex's network budgets (live/pr-matrix/harness/codex/budgets.yaml, network_budget.py, scripts/e2e-network-budget.sh). Only the paid harness is a double (harness_double.sh around the shipped mock harness) and the internet a loopback server; the shim, the namespace, the suites and the onebudgetspec check run for real, and the paid live-codex pass is the real-harness drift alarm. JSON allows no narrower scope. The measuring tests need Linux, pasta and unprivileged user namespaces and skip saying why elsewhere, unless OH_NET_NO_SKIP=1 (ci.yml's Linux leg) makes that a failure. Its ruff and ty settings are the Python SDK's (ruff.toml extends them; `ty check --project python/oneharness-sdk` reads them), and ty assumes Linux on every leg: the recorder and its tests' doubles run there alone, and a Windows leg would otherwise refuse their os.fork.

commands: uv run --project python --frozen --no-sync ruff format --check --config tools/network-telemetry/ruff.toml scripts/e2e-netmeasure.py live/pr-matrix/harness/codex/network_budget.py live/control/app_server_rss_budget.py tools/network-telemetry
uv run --project python --frozen --no-sync ruff format --config tools/network-telemetry/ruff.toml scripts/e2e-netmeasure.py live/pr-matrix/harness/codex/network_budget.py tools/network-telemetry

uv run --project python --frozen --no-sync ruff check --config tools/network-telemetry/ruff.toml scripts/e2e-netmeasure.py live/pr-matrix/harness/codex/network_budget.py live/control/app_server_rss_budget.py tools/network-telemetry

uv run --project python --frozen --no-sync ty check --project python/oneharness-sdk --python-platform linux --extra-search-path tools/network-telemetry scripts/e2e-netmeasure.py live/pr-matrix/harness/codex/network_budget.py live/control/app_server_rss_budget.py tools/network-telemetry/*.py
